sql:
with t as (
 select p.market_ticker mt, split_part(p.market_ticker,'-',2) d, split_part(p.market_ticker,'-',3) city, p.created_at, p.assumed_price px, p.quantity q, p.pnl, p.status, p.side, s.close_time
 from paper_trades p left join mmsell_settlement_meta s on s.market_ticker=p.market_ticker
 where p.market_ticker like 'KXRAIN-%' and p.strategy like '%mmsell%' and p.strategy not like '%\_pt%' and p.status in ('settled','closed_sl')
), m as (
 select mt, d, city, min(created_at) fe, avg(px) px, max(close_time) ct, max(case when status='settled' and pnl<0 then 1 else 0 end) lost, sum(q) q, sum(pnl) pnl, count(*) n, min(side) side
 from t group by 1,2,3
), x as (
 select 'a_band' dim, case when px>=95 then '95+' when px>=93 then '93-94' when px>=90 then '90-92' when px>=85 then '85-89' else '<85' end k, * from m
 union all select 'b_htc', case when ct is null then 'null' when extract(epoch from ct-fe)/3600<3 then '0-3h' when extract(epoch from ct-fe)/3600<6 then '03-6h' when extract(epoch from ct-fe)/3600<12 then '06-12h' when extract(epoch from ct-fe)/3600<24 then '12-24h' else '24h+' end, * from m
 union all select 'c_month', to_char(fe,'YYYY-MM'), * from m
 union all select 'd_city', city, * from m
 union all select 'e_side', side, * from m
 union all select 'f_entryhourUTC', lpad(extract(hour from fe)::text,2,'0'), * from m
)
select dim, k, count(*) mkts, count(distinct d) dates, sum(lost) lost, round(avg(100-px),1) impl_yes, round(100.0*sum(lost)/count(*),1) real_yes, sum(n) trades, sum(q) ctr, round(100*sum(pnl)/sum(q),2) c_ct, round(sum(pnl),2) pnl
from x group by 1,2 order by 1,2
